description: Phase 10: Final Verification. Run full test suite with coverage report, execute python manage.py check and check --deploy, fix any failing tests or check warnings, ensure all migrations are consistent with no missing migrations, create and execute manual test checklist for all 3 role flows, document testing procedures in docs/TESTING.md, and perform final integration verification.
steps: 1. Run full test suite: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py test --verbosity=2
2. If any tests fail, fix the failures and re-run until all pass
3. Run coverage: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage run --source='.' manage.py test
4. Generate coverage report: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage report --show-missing
5. Generate HTML coverage report: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage html
6. If coverage < 80%, identify gaps in htmlcov/index.html and add tests to reach 80%+
7. Run check: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check
8. Run check --deploy: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check --deploy
9. Fix any errors from check commands. For warnings, document in TESTING.md if acceptable (e.g., DEBUG=True in dev is expected)
10. Run makemigrations --dry-run to check for missing migrations: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations --dry-run --check
11. If migrations missing, run makemigrations and commit them
12. Run migrate to ensure database schema is current: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate
13. Create docs/TESTING.md with sections: Testing Overview, Automated Tests (how to run, coverage), Manual Test Checklist, Known Issues, Test Data

14. In TESTING.md Manual Test Checklist, add Job Seeker Flow: register -> verify email -> login -> complete profile (add education, experience, upload resume) -> verify completeness meter updates -> browse jobs -> filter jobs by category/skill/location/job_type -> view job detail -> save job -> apply to job with cover letter -> view my applications -> view application detail with status timeline -> withdraw application -> create job alert -> verify notification bell shows count -> view notifications -> view saved jobs

15. In TESTING.md Manual Test Checklist, add Recruiter Flow: register as EMPLOYEE -> login -> create company profile (logo, industry, size, location, about) -> wait for admin approval (or approve in admin) -> create job with category, skills, location, job_type, salary, deadline -> verify job appears in job list (if no moderation or after approval) -> view my jobs -> receive notification when job seeker applies -> view applicants list for job -> filter/sort applicants -> click applicant to view detail (profile, resume download, application, status, notes) -> schedule interview -> add note on applicant -> rate applicant -> change application status to SHORTLISTED -> verify applicant receives email notification -> select multiple applicants -> bulk action to REJECTED -> export applicants CSV -> access employee dashboard -> verify stats and recent activity

16. In TESTING.md Manual Test Checklist, add Admin Flow: login as admin -> access /manage/ admin dashboard -> verify Chart.js charts render (users/jobs/applications over time) -> verify stat cards show counts -> navigate to user management -> search for user -> view user detail -> deactivate user -> verify AuditLog created -> navigate to company management -> filter by PENDING status -> approve company -> verify company status changes to VERIFIED -> navigate to job management -> if JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED=True, view moderation queue -> approve job -> verify job visible in public listing -> navigate to job reports -> view report detail -> mark as resolved -> navigate to contact messages -> mark message as read -> navigate to audit logs -> filter by action type -> verify all admin actions logged
17. Execute Job Seeker flow manually, check off each step, document any issues
18. Execute Recruiter flow manually, check off each step, document any issues
19. Execute Admin flow manually, check off each step, document any issues
20. Test error pages: trigger 403 (access admin page as non-admin), 404 (visit /nonexistent/), 500 (temporarily break a view). Verify custom error pages render.
21. Test sitemap.xml and robots.txt accessibility
22. Verify email notifications: apply to job, change status, schedule interview - check console for email output (or real email if configured)

23. Test management commands: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py send_job_alerts (verify matches jobs to alerts), C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py expire_jobs (create job with past deadline, run command, verify job marked inactive)
24. Document all manual test results in TESTING.md with PASS/FAIL status and any notes
25. Fix any critical issues found during manual testing
26. Re-run automated tests after fixes to ensure nothing broken
27. Final commit: 'Phase 10: Final verification complete with comprehensive testing'
